capabilities: Sync selected Dedao Brain knowledge bases into per-knowledge-base folders
File subscribed blogger posts under blogger-name subfolders
Run scheduled incremental sync from the last checkpoint at 5-minute or longer intervals
Render speech-to-text transcripts into the main Markdown note
Keep attachment import (images, audio, video, documents) disabled by default
disambiguation: Does not sync Dedao Reading highlights, annotations, or reflections; the README says those belong in a separate future plugin.
extras: Can be installed via BRAT for beta testing. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns users to comply with Dedao Brain's terms, membership permissions, and API quota limits.
intentEvidence: This plugin is derived from AndyZhengyan/obsidian-dedao-brain-sync under the MIT license.
motivation: The author forked obsidian-dedao-brain-sync to add knowledge-base folder organization, subscribed blogger filing, scheduled incremental sync, and conservative attachment handling.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Dedao Brain knowledge-base and subscribed blogger content into a vault as organized local Markdown.

relations.evidence: This plugin is derived from AndyZhengyan/obsidian-dedao-brain-sync under the MIT license.

summary: Syncs Dedao Brain (GetNote) knowledge bases and subscribed blogger content into local Markdown files organized by knowledge-base and blogger folders.
